Q: How to disable Asp.Net MVC controller? A:

Use the built-in [ApiExplorerSettings(IgnoreApi = true)] to make ASP.NET Core ignore the controller at runtime.

Q: How to Decompile Bytenode "jsc" files? A:

If you're working with Node 8 / V8 6.x .jsc files, I built an open-source decompiler that recovers readable JavaScript from the bytecode: https://github.com/girish0x0/jsc_decompiler — supports if/else, loops, closures, async/await, classes, generators, and more. Pure Python, no dependencies.

Q: "FirefoxDriver cannot be resolved to a type" when running Selenium webdriver A:

Try adding selenium stand alone server(https://docs.seleniumhq.org/download/) to your project (even though you are using maven), as an external jar and try. For me this resolution worked. Right click on your Maven project > Properties > Java Buildpath > Libraries tab Click on Add External jar button > Browse to the folder where the jar is saved > upload >Apply and close

Q: Installing eclipse neon on windows 10 A:

Try Eclipse Oxygen (newer than Neon). I had problems with the installer that the Eclipse team recommends, so I downloaded and extracted the zip file under "Eclipse IDE for Java EE Developers" / "64 bit" on http://www.eclipse.org/downloads/eclipse-packages/ (direct link: http://www.eclipse.org/downloads/download.php?file=/technology/epp/downloads/release/oxygen/1/eclipse-jee-oxygen-1-win32-x86_64.zip)

Then reference your Java version in the eclipse.ini file. Search for

-vm
C:\Java\JDK\1.8\bin\javaw.exe

on https://wiki.eclipse.org/Eclipse.ini for details.

Q: Error during WebSocket handshake: Unexpected response code: 200 A:

You need to check the following:

  • Apache allows requests to files with the .ws extension
  • Your WebSocket module's .so file is copied into the correct location
  • Your WebSocket module is switched on
  • There is no setting in your .conf and/or .htaccess file which prevents the request
  • PHP version is new-enough to support your PHP extension
  • Your PHP extension is copied into the correct location
  • Your PHP extension is switched on
  • Everything you needed to install is installed
  • Your IPC file works well and is fresh
  • Your SymLinks, if any are correct
  • All the paths having any role in WebSocket usage are correct

I know you have left PHP for .NET, but if you or anybody else want to solve this issue, then this is my suggestion as ideas to do so. At least this is how I solved my similar problem.
